hero.subtitle: and I build AI-powered micro apps
hero.description-1: I'm a licensed civil engineer with 9 years of experience in construction supervision and technical office work, and a graduate of Front-end and Back-end Systems Development at IDAT. I know the day-to-day problems of a construction site first-hand, and now I also build the tools to solve them.
hero.description-2: I use AI as part of my development workflow to build micro apps: small, focused applications that solve one specific need and are made to be used for real, like Yanashpa Proyectos, which is in use on site today, and Marea. My main stack is React, TypeScript, Supabase and Java.

items.name: Front-end and Back-end Systems Development - IDAT
items.description: Graduated having passed 100% of the curriculum. Object-oriented programming with Java, web and mobile development with React and React Native, relational and non-relational databases, web services, design patterns and software quality. Cloud computing with AWS, DevOps with Docker and Jenkins, cybersecurity, secure application development and artificial intelligence. Applied projects integrating the data, business and view layers, built with agile methodologies.

items.name: Oracle Next Education Front-end Program
items.description: Front-end development with React and JavaScript: components, navigation, Styled Components, Hooks and API consumption. HTML, responsive CSS, TypeScript, DOM manipulation and AI integration with ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot. Complemented by training in personal development, agile fundamentals and entrepreneurship.

items.name: Civil Engineering - National University of San Martín
items.description: Bachelor's degree and professional title in Civil Engineering, licensed by the Peruvian College of Engineers (CIP) since 2019. Since 2017 I have worked in technical office, technical project files and construction supervision on road, education, healthcare, sanitation, commercial and housing projects for the public and private sectors.
